requirements.invariant: Actual is the only posted finance ledger; n8n Postgres and cashback state contain no duplicate posted ledger.

verifier.expected: Every posted identity enumerates exactly once in Actual and zero times in operational stores.

requirements.invariant: Every FAB non-credit-card account found in the authenticated portal exists once in Actual with an evidenced as-of balance.

verifier.expected: Hash-bound portal inventory and archive evidence enumerate every FAB non-credit account and match Actual signed balances exactly.

requirements.invariant: Each included Sarwa portfolio is represented once as an off-budget valuation account from immutable holdings and FX snapshots.

verifier.expected: Hash-bound T1/T2 holdings and FX evidence reconcile positions, cash, stable identities, delta valuations, idempotent replay, and off-budget Actual readback.

requirements.invariant: The closed ADCB card retains history, is excluded from routing, and reads AED 0 without a synthetic balancing row.

verifier.expected: Issuer-evidenced consecutive statements reach exactly zero without a synthetic adjustment, and Actual reads closed with retained history.

requirements.invariant: Adapters finalize source direction and topic before classification and later stages cannot mutate protected fields.

verifier.expected: All direction, topic, amount, and sign mutation regressions pass.

verifier.expected: Full-corpus scan reports zero grammar violations and reviewed UI samples match.

requirements.invariant: Every transaction is resolved or appears exactly once in a review queue with category, tag, owner, and property invariants.

verifier.expected: Unresolved count equals review-queue count and no row violates protected-field or property invariants.

requirements.invariant: Manual corrections, reconciliations, splits, transfers, schedules, and notes survive replay or explicitly block promotion.

verifier.expected: Before and after fingerprints are identical except for an approved reviewed delta.

requirements.invariant: The complete corpus replays twice into disposable Actual with no duplicates, drift, missing IDs, semantic errors, or lost manual state.

verifier.expected: Two replay receipts have identical counts, balances, hashes, and zero violations.

requirements.invariant: Actual UI and API identify the same file, accounts, transactions, signed balances, and net worth.

verifier.expected: UI and API sync IDs, stable account sets, lifecycle state, signed balances, history hashes, and aggregate net worth are equal.

requirements.invariant: Durable and high-value purchases acquire exact evidence while excluded purchases do not, and all binaries reconcile to the catalogue.

verifier.expected: Positive, negative, ambiguous, hash, path, and transaction-link fixtures pass end to end.

requirements.invariant: Approved budgets, schedules, owners, properties, savings, subscriptions, and named reports reconcile to authoritative data.

verifier.expected: All named functional inventory items exist, are populated, and pass equation and readback checks.

requirements.invariant: n8n alone owns schedules, cursor-safe acquisition, visible ETL, bounded AI handoff, durable receipts, and recovery without a bridge.

verifier.expected: The exact image imports and executes every non-placeholder flow with no unknown nodes or bridge dependencies.

requirements.invariant: n8n hands only redacted unresolved fields to an isolated ephemeral Codex runner, receives a schema-valid proposal, and never gives the runner ledger credentials or authority to mutate protected fields.

verifier.command: npm test --prefix services/codex-agent-runner && python -m unittest tests.test_n8n_workflows -v
verifier.expected: Three deterministic fixture runs produce idempotent schema-valid proposals through ChatGPT subscription auth; malicious output, protected-field writes, arbitrary commands, API-key fallback, and credential access are rejected.

requirements.invariant: Encrypted and plain PDFs use a fixed networkless resource-bounded utility and no decrypted content survives success or failure.

verifier.expected: Encrypted, corrupt, polyglot, oversize, timeout, OOM, network, and retention fixtures fail safely.

requirements.invariant: Successful scheduled runs do not accumulate per-run Codex tasks while failed runs remain visible and auditable.

verifier.expected: Three consecutive n8n-owned runs create durable receipts and no new per-run Codex tasks.

requirements.invariant: Actual, cashback, n8n, and Postgres restore into disposable environments and every independent service survives controlled restart.

verifier.expected: Restore hashes, credential decrypt, service health, and interrupted outbox and cursor recovery pass.

requirements.invariant: Every mail run freezes its upper bound, exhausts pagination, emits an empty heartbeat, and advances its cursor once after durable success.

verifier.expected: Zero, 101-plus, late, duplicate, out-of-order, and failure-boundary fixtures lose no messages.

requirements.invariant: One fenced writer advances PREPARED to COMMITTED only after Actual observation and verification, with deterministic IDs and crash recovery.

verifier.expected: Concurrent and kill-at-boundary tests yield one Actual row, one committed outbox, and one cursor advance.

requirements.invariant: Each static action has exactly one owner: Actual when representable, otherwise deterministic n8n, with an empty overlap report.

verifier.expected: Compiler parity passes and the overlap report is empty.

requirements.invariant: Runtime secrets originate in a dedicated 1Password vault, never persist in env, workflow, log, execution, or backup data, and decrypt after restore.

verifier.expected: Cold start, rotation, restore, inspect, log, execution, and repository scans reveal no secret values.

requirements.invariant: Two tunnel containers reach allowlisted n8n routes over private Docker DNS; UI is AD-protected, MCP uses Service Auth, and no origin is LAN-published.

verifier.expected: Authorized routes succeed, unauthorized routes fail, origin scan is empty, and callback and WebSocket tests pass.

requirements.invariant: Instance MCP is disabled and a dedicated trigger exposes only allowlisted status, reviewed-artifact, and document-request operations.

verifier.expected: Unknown, write-capable, caller-selected path or ID, and unauthenticated MCP requests are rejected.
